identityStatus: The current named building footprint fixes all four sides. The public-domain historic view and restoration record establish the wrapping galleries and recessed solid core.

terrainContact.basis: Original Copernicus surface elevation on the access drive on the south side of the house.

notes: Shown are the ground-floor open semicircular arcades, paired upper columns, dark timber doors, parapet and high center jack roof. The conservation record specifies limewash and clay tiles.
